title: How a Solar Flare Reaches Earth in Eight Minutes

post_description: What a solar flare is, how fast it arrives and what shields us, from NASA and NOAA. Sources: National Aeronautics and Space Administration https://science.nasa.gov/sun/solar-storms-and-flares/ and National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration https://www.ncei.noaa.gov/news/what-is-space-weather #Science #ScienceFacts #QuantaTale
narration: What happens when the Sun suddenly blasts out a burst of energy? A solar flare is a sudden, intense burst of radiation from the Sun. No other explosion in the solar system is more powerful. The largest pack the energy of a huge number of hydrogen bombs. They start when twisted magnetic fields on the Sun snap and reconnect. Its energy travels at light speed, so it reaches Earth within minutes. Earth's atmosphere and magnetic field shield us on the ground. Strong flares can still disrupt radio signals and affect satellites.
